supersedes.description: the pinned last revisions of the blocks this one replaces (TY-03, RF-12)

stage.description: the stage contract revision the step runs (RT-01)

params.description: the static params of the stage, checked against the params type of its contract when the pipeline is validated (RT-02); any value, which the subset cannot say: closed until the kernel takes the keyword of S0-53 (G-38)

reads.description: the context fields the stage reads (RT-03)

writes.description: the context fields the stage writes (RT-03)

on.description: an action per status the stage contract declares; fallback runs the stage of field fallback (RT-04, G-40)

fallback.description: the one alternative stage that action fallback runs in place; it writes the same fields and has no on of its own (RT-04, RT-05, G-40)

stages.description: the stages in order: no backward jumps, no loops (RT-01, RT-05)

bench.description: the bench set it is measured on, set@n (RT-01, BN-02); no label of TY-16 says measured on (G-42)

targets.description: a target per metric of measure (RT-01, BN-07, BN-12)

tolerance.description: the regression tolerance, no smaller than measured noise (BN-12)
